title: Horsford identity disambiguation and Pringle-network register
purpose: Prevent premature merging of the unidentified Horsford partner in Gillett & Horsford, Southwick, Massachusetts, with Frederick Hinsdale Horsford of the Pringle/Watson/Charlotte, Vermont network while preserving both as research leads.

southwick_firm.direct_blaschka_link: Blaschka workshop letter of 19 July 1891 states that a California Fritillaria bulb had been sent the previous year by Gillett & Horsford, Southwick Mass.
southwick_firm.harvard_metadata: HOLLIS describes an 1891 folder as letters from Edward Gillett of Gillett and Horsford, plant nursery in Southwick, MA.
southwick_firm.primary_stationery: Pass 38 verifies repeated OCR of Southwick Nurseries (Gillett & Horsford) letterhead in the Edward Gillett-to-Watson block.

research_use: possible identity bridge to test rather than assume

identity_hypothesis.hypothesis: Frederick Hinsdale Horsford was the Horsford partner in Gillett & Horsford, Southwick, Massachusetts
identity_hypothesis.current_support: surname, chronology and shared Harvard/Watson environment only
identity_hypothesis.current_counterweight: Frederick Hinsdale Horsford is independently documented in a Pringle/Charlotte Vermont network; no inspected source explicitly places him in the Southwick partnership
identity_hypothesis.decision_rule: Do not merge actor IDs without a contemporary source explicitly connecting Frederick Hinsdale Horsford to Gillett & Horsford/Southwick or otherwise identifying the Southwick partner.
